_about: Source of truth for name spellings in the novel. tools/style_check.py flags 'flag' variants and 'not_vyasa' names; tools/build_index.py renders workbook/NAMES.md and index/CHARACTER_INDEX.md from this file. Rules: ś/ṣ -> sh, c -> ch, ṛ -> ri, no diacritics in the novel, v not w, n-stems and -mat/-vat stems in their familiar nominative (Shikhandi, Ashvatthama, Iravan, Hanuman). 'dialogue' lists alternates a character may use in speech; the narrator always uses 'name'. Add people as they enter the story.

people.name: Ugrashravas
people.who: the bard, son of Lomaharshana, who tells the epic in the Naimisha forest

people.name: Shaunaka
people.who: head of the household of sages in the Naimisha forest; also a brahmin skilled in yoga and Samkhya who teaches Yudhishthira in the forest (3.2.14)

people.name: Lomaharshana
people.who: father of Ugrashravas, a bard

people.name: Janamejaya
people.who: king of the Kurus, great-grandson of Arjuna; the snake sacrifice is his; also a king Drupada would summon (5.4.22)

people.name: Vaishampayana
people.who: Vyasa's pupil, who tells the epic to Janamejaya

people.name: Vyasa
people.who: Krishna Dvaipayana, son of Parashara and Satyavati; maker of the epic and father of Dhritarashtra, Pandu and Vidura

people.name: Parikshit
people.who: son of Abhimanyu and Uttara; father of Janamejaya; killed by the snake Takshaka; also Parikshit of Ayodhya, an Ikshvaku king who marries the frog king's daughter (3.190.3)

people.name: Shantanu
people.who: king of Hastinapura; husband of Ganga, then of Satyavati; father of Bhishma

people.name: Ganga
people.who: the river goddess; Shantanu's first wife; Bhishma's mother

people.name: Bhishma
people.who: Devavrata, son of Shantanu and Ganga, who vowed never to marry or rule

people.name: Satyavati
people.who: the fisherman's adopted daughter who became Shantanu's queen; mother of Vyasa

people.name: Chitrangada
people.who: elder son of Shantanu and Satyavati. The same name belongs to Chitravahana's daughter of Manalura, Arjuna's wife and mother of Babhruvahana (1.207.15), and to a suitor king (1.177.20)

people.name: Vichitravirya
people.who: younger son of Shantanu and Satyavati; husband of Ambika and Ambalika

people.name: Amba
people.who: eldest princess of Kashi, carried off by Bhishma

people.name: Ambika
people.who: princess of Kashi; Vichitravirya's wife; mother of Dhritarashtra. The Kausalya of Rama's story, Rama's mother (3.258.8), is a different woman

people.name: Ambalika
people.who: princess of Kashi; Vichitravirya's wife; mother of Pandu

people.name: Dhritarashtra
people.who: blind elder son of Vyasa and Ambika; father of Duryodhana and his brothers

people.name: Pandu
people.who: pale son of Vyasa and Ambalika; king; father of the Pandavas

people.name: Vidura
people.who: son of Vyasa and a serving woman; Dharma born as a man; wise counsellor

people.name: Gandhari
people.who: princess of Gandhara; Dhritarashtra's wife, who bound her own eyes

people.name: Shakuni
people.who: Gandhari's brother, son of Subala; the dice player

people.name: Kunti
people.who: Pritha, daughter of Shura, adopted by Kuntibhoja; Pandu's senior wife; mother of Karna, Yudhishthira, Bhima and Arjuna

people.name: Madri
people.who: princess of Madra, Shalya's sister; Pandu's second wife; mother of Nakula and Sahadeva

people.name: Karna
people.who: Kunti's first son, by the Sun, born with armour and earrings; raised by the charioteer Adhiratha and Radha

people.name: Adhiratha
people.who: the charioteer (suta) who raised Karna

people.name: Radha
people.who: Adhiratha's wife, Karna's foster mother. The only Radha in the epic (see ledger L-58)

people.name: Yudhishthira
people.who: eldest son of Kunti, by Dharma; the dharma king

people.name: Bhima
people.who: second son of Kunti, by Vayu the wind; immensely strong; also the name of the king of Vidarbha, Damayanti's father (3.50.5), inside Brihadashva's tale only

people.name: Arjuna
people.who: third son of Kunti, by Indra; the great archer

people.name: Nakula
people.who: elder of Madri's twin sons, by the Ashvins

people.name: Sahadeva
people.who: younger of Madri's twin sons, by the Ashvins; also the name of Jarasandha's son, consecrated king of Magadha by Krishna (2.20.29; 2.22.39)

people.name: Draupadi
people.who: daughter of Drupada, born from the sacrificial altar; wife of the five Pandavas

people.name: Duryodhana
people.who: eldest son of Dhritarashtra and Gandhari; born of a portion of Kali

people.name: Duhshasana
people.who: second son of Dhritarashtra and Gandhari

people.name: Vikarna
people.who: a son of Dhritarashtra who speaks for Draupadi in the hall

people.name: Duhshala
people.who: Dhritarashtra and Gandhari's one daughter; wife of Jayadratha

people.name: Yuyutsu
people.who: Dhritarashtra's son by a vaishya woman

people.name: Jayadratha
people.who: king of the Sindhus; Duhshala's husband

people.name: Kripa
people.who: teacher of the princes; son of Sharadvat

people.name: Kripi
people.who: Kripa's twin sister; Drona's wife

people.name: Drona
people.who: Brahmin master of arms, son of Bharadvaja, born in a pot; also the name of the youngest of the four Sharngaka fledglings (1.221.9)

people.name: Ashvatthama
people.who: son of Drona and Kripi

people.name: Drupada
people.who: king of the Panchalas, Drona's childhood friend and enemy

people.name: Dhrishtadyumna
people.who: Drupada's son, born from the sacrificial fire to kill Drona

people.name: Shikhandi
people.who: Drupada's child, born a daughter, who became a man; Amba reborn

people.name: Krishna
people.who: son of Vasudeva and Devaki, of the Vrishni clan; Arjuna's friend and charioteer

people.name: Balarama
people.who: Krishna's elder brother, the plough-bearer

people.name: Satyaki
people.who: Vrishni hero, Arjuna's pupil and ally

people.name: Kritavarma
people.who: Bhoja/Vrishni warrior who fights for the Kauravas

people.name: Subhadra
people.who: Krishna's sister; Arjuna's wife; mother of Abhimanyu

people.name: Abhimanyu
people.who: son of Arjuna and Subhadra

people.name: Ghatotkacha
people.who: son of Bhima and the rakshasi Hidimba

people.name: Hidimba
people.who: a rakshasa brother and sister of the forest. Bhima kills the brother and marries the sister. In English the names collide, so give context until the brother is dead

people.name: Virata
people.who: king of the Matsyas, host of the Pandavas' year in hiding

people.name: Shalya
people.who: king of Madra, Madri's brother

people.name: Sanjaya
people.who: Dhritarashtra's charioteer and counsellor, given divine sight by Vyasa; returns the kings' courtesies at the Rajasuya (2.32.5); also one of the twelve Sauvira princes who follow Jayadratha (3.249.10)

people.name: Iravan
people.who: Arjuna's son by a daughter of the snake king, unnamed in the CE (6.86.6-8; the vulgate makes her Ulupi, ledger L-103); dies in battle (not a self-sacrifice: ledger L-37)

people.name: Takshaka
people.who: the snake king who kills Parikshit

people.name: Uttanka
people.who: pupil of Veda who fetches the queen's earrings and urges Janamejaya to take revenge; also the seer of the desert whose hermitage Dhundhu troubles; Vishnu grants him a boon (3.192–195)

people.name: Astika
people.who: son of Jaratkaru and Vasuki's sister; he stops the snake sacrifice

people.name: Rama Jamadagnya
people.who: son of Jamadagni, the Bhrigu warrior-brahmin who destroyed the kshatriyas and made the five lakes of blood; later Bhishma's opponent and Karna's teacher. The CE never calls him 'Parashurama' (ledger L-62): write 'Rama, son of Jamadagni', 'Rama Jamadagnya' or 'Bhargava Rama'

people.name: Sarama
people.who: the dog of the gods, who curses Janamejaya

people.name: Somashravas
people.who: Janamejaya's family priest, son of Shrutashravas by a snake-woman

people.name: Shrutashravas
people.who: seer, father of Somashravas

people.name: Dhaumya of the Ayodas
people.who: teacher of Aruni, Upamanyu and Veda. NOT the Dhaumya who becomes the Pandavas' priest (1.174)

people.name: Aruni
people.who: Dhaumya's pupil, renamed Uddalaka

people.name: Upamanyu
people.who: Dhaumya's pupil who praised the Ashvins

people.name: Veda
people.who: Dhaumya's pupil, later teacher of Uttanka and priest of Janamejaya and Paushya

people.name: Paushya
people.who: king whose queen gives her earrings to Uttanka

people.name: Bhrigu
people.who: seer, son of Brahma, ancestor of the Bhargavas (Shaunaka's line)

people.name: Puloma
people.who: Bhrigu's wife, mother of Chyavana (the rakshasa is Puloman); also a daitya woman, mother of the Paulomas (3.170.6)

people.name: Puloman
people.who: the rakshasa who carries off Bhrigu's wife

people.name: Chyavana
people.who: son of Bhrigu, 'the Fallen One'

people.name: Pramati
people.who: son of Chyavana and Sukanya; father of Ruru

people.name: Ruru
people.who: son of Pramati; gives half his life to Pramadvara

people.name: Pramadvara
people.who: daughter of Vishvavasu and Menaka, raised by Sthulakesha; Ruru's wife

people.name: Shunaka
people.who: son of Ruru; ancestor of Shaunaka

people.name: Sthulakesha
people.who: seer who raised Pramadvara

people.name: Menaka
people.who: an apsaras; mother of Pramadvara (and, later, of Shakuntala)

people.name: Vishvavasu
people.who: king of the gandharvas, father of Pramadvara; also the gandharva freed from Kabandha's body (3.263.38)

people.name: Sahasrapat
people.who: seer cursed to be a dundubha snake

people.name: Khagama
people.who: brahmin who cursed his friend Sahasrapat

people.name: Agni
people.who: the fire god

people.name: Indra
people.who: king of the gods

people.name: Brahma
people.who: the creator, grandfather of the worlds

people.name: Yama
people.who: lord of the dead, also called king of dharma

people.name: Kashyapa
people.who: lord of creatures, husband of Kadru and Vinata, father of the snakes, Aruna and Garuda (1.14); the same name is borne by the brahmin healer whom Takshaka turns back from saving Parikshit (1.38–39)

people.name: Jaratkaru
people.who: a Yayavara seer of strict vows who marries only a bride of his own name; Astika's father. His wife, Vasuki's sister, has the same name (1.13.34)

people.name: Vasuki
people.who: king of the snakes; the rope at the churning; gives his sister Jaratkaru to the seer Jaratkaru

people.name: Kadru
people.who: daughter of the creator, wife of Kashyapa, mother of a thousand nagas; also a king Drupada would summon (5.4.21)

people.name: Vinata
people.who: daughter of the creator, wife of Kashyapa, mother of Aruna and Garuda

people.name: Aruna
people.who: Vinata's elder son, born half-formed from the broken egg; seen at dawn

people.name: Garuda
people.who: Vinata's younger son, the destroyer of snakes

people.name: Vishnu
people.who: the god who counsels the churning, takes a woman's form to win back the nectar, and wields the discus Sudarshana

people.name: Nara
people.who: the god who fights beside Narayana with a divine bow

people.name: Ananta
people.who: the mighty god who tears up Mandara for the churning

people.name: Akupara
people.who: king of the tortoises; the base of Mandara at the churning (not called an avatar of Vishnu; see L-64); also the long-lived tortoise of Indradyumna's lake who remembers the king (3.191.14–18)

people.name: Varuna
people.who: lord of the waters; the ocean asks for a share of the nectar

people.name: Shri
people.who: goddess of fortune, risen from the churned butter

people.name: Dhanvantari
people.who: the god who rises from the ocean carrying the nectar in a white pot

people.name: Rahu
people.who: a danava who drinks the nectar disguised as a god; his head is cut off by the discus

people.name: Brihaspati
people.who: priest and counsellor of the gods; explains the omens to Indra

people.name: Vibhavasu
people.who: an angry seer who curses his brother to become an elephant and is himself cursed to become a tortoise

people.name: Supratika
people.who: Vibhavasu's younger brother, who wanted their wealth divided; becomes the elephant

people.name: Bhauvana
people.who: a mighty guardian of the soma, struck down by Garuda (not identified further in the CE)

people.name: Shesha
people.who: eldest of the snakes; leaves his brothers for austerity and holds up the earth at Brahma's command

people.name: Elapatra
people.who: the snake who remembers Brahma's words and counsels Vasuki to give his sister to Jaratkaru

people.name: Airavata
people.who: a chief naga, brother of Vasuki; also Indra's elephant, king of elephants (5.18.1)

people.name: Shamika
people.who: the silent sage on whose shoulder Parikshit hangs a dead snake; father of Shringin

people.name: Shringin
people.who: Shamika's hot-tempered son, who curses Parikshit

people.name: Krisha
people.who: a seer's son, Shringin's friend, whose teasing provokes the curse

people.name: Gauramukha
people.who: Shamika's pupil, sent to warn Parikshit

people.name: Vapushtama
people.who: daughter of Suvarnavarman of Kashi; Janamejaya's wife

people.name: Suvarnavarman
people.who: king of Kashi, Vapushtama's father

people.name: Lohitaksha
people.who: the red-eyed suta, builder of Janamejaya's place of sacrifice, who foretold that a brahmin would stop the rite

people.name: Uparichara Vasu
people.who: king of Chedi, Indra's friend, who rides above the earth in a crystal chariot; father of Satyavati and Matsya

people.name: Girika
people.who: Vasu's wife, daughter of the mountain Kolahala and the river Shuktimati

people.name: Adrika
people.who: an apsaras cursed to be a fish in the Yamuna; mother of Satyavati and Matsya

people.name: Matsya
people.who: the king born with Satyavati from the fish; founder of the Matsya line

people.name: Parashara
people.who: son of Shakti; father of Vyasa by Satyavati

people.name: Animandavya
people.who: the seer impaled as a thief who cursed Dharma to be born as Vidura

people.name: Gavalgana
people.who: the suta, father of Sanjaya

people.name: Shuka
people.who: Vyasa's son and pupil; also one of Ravana's counsellors, caught spying as a monkey (3.267.52)

people.name: Dushyanta
people.who: Paurava king who marries Shakuntala by the gandharva rite and later denies her until a heavenly voice speaks; father of Bharata

people.name: Shakuntala
people.who: daughter of Vishvamitra and Menaka, raised by Kanva; wife of Dushyanta, mother of Bharata

people.name: Kanva
people.who: the Kashyapa seer on the Malini who raised Shakuntala

people.name: Vishvamitra
people.who: a kshatriya who became a brahmin by austerity; father of Shakuntala by Menaka

people.name: Bharata
people.who: son of Dushyanta and Shakuntala, first called Sarvadamana; the emperor from whom the Bharatas take their name; also son of Dasharatha and Kaikeyi, who rules from Nandigrama with Rama's sandals before him (3.261.38)

people.name: Manu
people.who: Manu son of Vivasvat (through Martanda in 1.70), from whom the human race descends; the fish saves him from the flood (3.185)

people.name: Pururavas
people.who: son of Ila, husband of Urvashi, ancestor of the Lunar line

people.name: Urvashi
people.who: the apsaras, wife of Pururavas

people.name: Nahusha
people.who: son of Ayus, father of Yayati; for a time he made himself Indra; cursed by Agastya to be a serpent, he seizes Bhima and is freed by Yudhishthira's answers (3.176–178); also made king of the gods while Indra hid; demanded Shachi; yoked the seers to his carriage (5.11–17)

people.name: Yayati
people.who: son of Nahusha, husband of Devayani and Sharmishtha, who traded his old age for Puru's youth

people.name: Puru
people.who: Yayati's youngest son, by Sharmishtha, who took his father's old age; founder of the Paurava line

people.name: Yadu
people.who: Yayati's eldest son, by Devayani; ancestor of the Yadavas

people.name: Turvasu
people.who: Yayati's son by Devayani

people.name: Druhyu
people.who: Yayati's son by Sharmishtha

people.name: Anu
people.who: Yayati's son by Sharmishtha

people.name: Shukra
people.who: Kavya Ushanas, priest of the asuras, who knows how to raise the dead; father of Devayani

people.name: Kacha
people.who: son of Brihaspati, who learns the art of raising the dead from Shukra; also Kacha (Kāca), a lord of Vanga defeated by Bhima (2.27.22)

people.name: Devayani
people.who: daughter of Shukra; wife of Yayati; mother of Yadu and Turvasu

people.name: Sharmishtha
people.who: daughter of the asura king Vrishaparvan; Devayani's rival and servant; mother of Druhyu, Anu and Puru

people.name: Vrishaparvan
people.who: king of the asuras, Shukra's patron, father of Sharmishtha; also a royal seer whose hermitage lies below Gandhamadana, where the Pandavas leave their brahmins (3.155.17–25); the text does not say whether he is the same

people.name: Ghurnika
people.who: Devayani's maid

people.name: Ashtaka
people.who: royal seer, a grandson of Yayati through his daughter, who questions and helps save him

people.name: Pratardana
people.who: royal seer, a grandson of Yayati through his daughter

people.name: Vasumanas
people.who: royal seer, son of Rushadashva, a grandson of Yayati through his daughter

people.name: Shibi
people.who: son of Ushinara, a royal seer of unequalled generosity, a grandson of Yayati through his daughter

people.name: Mahabhisha
people.who: a king of Ikshvaku's line in heaven, cursed by Brahma for gazing at Ganga; reborn as Shantanu

people.name: Pratipa
people.who: Kuru king, father of Devapi, Shantanu and Bahlika; Ganga sat on his right thigh

people.name: Devapi
people.who: Pratipa's eldest son, who left for the forest as a boy

people.name: Vasishtha
people.who: the seer, son of Varuna, also called Apava; cursed the Vasus; taught Devavrata the Vedas; a Vasishtha goes with Bharata to bring Rama back (3.261.36)

people.name: Dyaus
people.who: the Vasu who stole Vasishtha's cow and was reborn as Bhishma (not 'Prabhasa'; see L-69)

people.name: Shalva
people.who: king of the Shalvas and lord of Saubha, whom Amba had chosen; beaten by Bhishma at Varanasi; a Shalva, lord of Saubha, also attacks Dvaraka and is killed by Krishna (3.15–22). The CE calls both 'lord of Saubha' but does not say they are the same man

people.name: Utathya
people.who: seer, elder brother of Brihaspati, husband of Mamata

people.name: Mamata
people.who: wife of Utathya, mother of Dirghatamas

people.name: Dirghatamas
people.who: son of Utathya, cursed in the womb by Brihaspati to be born blind; fathers sons for King Bali

people.name: Bali
people.who: king who rescued Dirghatamas from the Ganga and had him father sons on his queen (not the asura Bali); also Bali, the asura son of Virochana and grandson of Prahlada (3.29); whose kingdom Vishnu took in the form of a dwarf (3.299.13)

people.name: Sudeshna
people.who: Bali's queen, mother of Anga by Dirghatamas (another Sudeshna is Virata's queen); also Virata's queen, a princess of the Kekayas, whom Draupadi serves as sairandhri (4.8.6)

people.name: Kakshivat
people.who: eldest of the eleven sons of Dirghatamas by Sudeshna's servant

people.name: Anga
people.who: royal seer, son of Dirghatamas by Sudeshna

people.name: Arjuna Kartavirya
people.who: thousand-armed king of the Haihayas, killed by Rama Jamadagnya; say 'Arjuna, the Haihaya king' to keep him apart from the Pandava

people.name: Subala
people.who: king of Gandhara, father of Gandhari and Shakuni; also an Ikshvaku king in Jayadratha's company (3.249.8), not Shakuni's father

people.name: Shura
people.who: chief of the Yadus, father of Vasudeva and of Pritha (Kunti); also one of the twelve Sauvira princes who follow Jayadratha; killed by Arjuna

people.name: Kuntibhoja
people.who: Shura's cousin, who adopted Pritha, hence 'Kunti'

people.name: Durvasas
people.who: the fierce brahmin who gave Pritha the mantra to call the gods

people.name: Dharma
people.who: the god of dharma, lord of the dead's justice; born as Vidura by Animandavya's curse

people.name: Bhaga
people.who: an Aditya whose eyes Shiva took away

people.name: Shiva
people.who: the great god; the CE also calls him Hara, Rudra, Mahadeva, Shankara; also Shiva, wife of Angiras, whose form Svaha takes (3.214.1)

people.name: Vasudeva
people.who: son of Shura, father of Krishna; Pritha's brother. Not Krishna's patronymic 'Vasudeva' (Vāsudeva), which the novel avoids as a name for Krishna where it would confuse

people.name: Darva
people.who: lord of Magadha killed at Rajagriha in Pandu's campaign (vulgate 'Dirgha')

people.name: Devaka
people.who: king whose daughter by a shudra woman married Vidura; also a king Drupada would summon (5.4.23)

people.name: Vivimshati
people.who: one of Dhritarashtra's sons

people.name: Kindama
people.who: the sage who, in a deer's form, was shot by Pandu while mating, and cursed him

people.name: Agastya
people.who: seer who hunted during a sacrifice and consecrated the deer to the gods; also the seer Nahusha touched with his foot, who cursed him to fall as a snake for ten thousand years (5.17.11–15)

people.name: Sharadandayani
people.who: a hero's wife who bore three sons, Durjaya and others, by a brahmin

people.name: Vyushitashva
people.who: Paurava king whose dead body gave his widow Bhadra seven sons

people.name: Bhadra
people.who: Vyushitashva's wife, daughter of Kakshivat; also the name of Kubera's wife (1.191.6); also Bhadra of Vaishali, carried off by Shishupala (2.42.11)

people.name: Kubera
people.who: lord of wealth, whose gardens lie on the northern mountains

people.name: Uddalaka
people.who: seer, father of Shvetaketu

people.name: Shvetaketu
people.who: Uddalaka's son, who made the rule of marital faithfulness

people.name: Madayanti
people.who: wife of Saudasa (Kalmashapada), mother of Ashmaka by Vasishtha

people.name: Kalmashapada
people.who: Ikshvaku king cursed by Shakti to eat men; freed by Vasishtha; father (by Vasishtha) of Ashmaka

people.name: Ashmaka
people.who: son of Madayanti by Vasishtha

people.name: Vayu
people.who: the Wind, father of Bhima

people.name: Ashvins
people.who: the twin gods, fathers of Nakula and Sahadeva

people.name: Tumburu
people.who: chief singer among the gandharvas

people.name: Somadatta
people.who: the Bahlika prince, Bhishma's cousin's son; father of Bhurishravas

people.name: Sharadvat
people.who: Gautama's son, the archer-seer, father of Kripa and Kripi

people.name: Jalapadi
people.who: the divine girl Indra sent to disturb Sharadvat

people.name: Bharadvaja
people.who: seer, Drona's father; also a hermit at Dyumatsena's hermitage (3.282.16)

people.name: Ghritachi
people.who: apsaras at whose sight Bharadvaja shed the seed that became Drona

people.name: Agniveshya
people.who: sage who received the weapon of Fire from Bharadvaja and taught Drona

people.name: Prishata
people.who: king of the Panchalas, Bharadvaja's friend, Drupada's father

people.name: Ekalavya
people.who: son of the Nishada king Hiranyadhanus; taught himself before a clay Drona and gave his thumb; also killed by Krishna, as Arjuna says (5.47.71; also 16.7.10) (5.47.71)

people.name: Hiranyadhanus
people.who: king of the Nishadas, Ekalavya's father

people.name: Dadhicha
people.who: seer from whose bones Indra's thunderbolt was made

people.name: Skanda
people.who: the war god, called Guha and Kumara; son of Fire, the Krittikas, Rudra and Ganga

people.name: Purochana
people.who: Duryodhana's minister who built the house of lac at Varanavata

people.name: Baka
people.who: man-eating rakshasa near Ekachakra, killed by Bhima

people.name: Yaja
people.who: Kashyapa seer who performed Drupada's sacrifice for a son

people.name: Upayaja
people.who: Yaja's younger brother, who refused Drupada and sent him to Yaja

people.name: Prishati
people.who: Drupada's queen, mother (by adoption of the fire-born twins) of Dhrishtadyumna and Draupadi

people.name: Angaraparna
